name: Cannibalistic Cousins
summary: In the Hinterlands, Mystic Yayo'jin asks you to strike at the Vilebranch near their temples. She calls them a depraved lot who prey on other trolls and humanoids. With Zul'jin away, the Revantusk are left to their own devices.

sections.title: Three Tribes, One Land
sections.body: Three troll tribes share the Hinterlands, though Mystic Yayo'jin says little binds them. The Vilebranch prey on other trolls and humanoids. Zul'jin could wipe them out with ease, but he is away. So the Revantusk are left to their own devices.

sections.title: Where the Vilebranch Gather
sections.body: Yayo'jin asks you to destroy the Vilebranch Scalpers and Soothsayers near the Shaol'watha and Agol'watha temples. The temples lie in the Hinterlands' north by northeast.

sections.title: Yayo'jin's Praise
sections.body: When you return, Yayo'jin says even Zul'jin could not have done better.

faq.answer: Mystic Yayo'jin offers it from Revantusk Village.

faq.q: Why does Yayo'jin want the Vilebranch destroyed?
faq.answer: Yayo'jin calls the Vilebranch a depraved lot who prey on other trolls and humanoids. She says the region's filth falls to you to destroy.

faq.q: Where can the Vilebranch trolls be found?
faq.answer: The Vilebranch gather around the Shaol'watha and Agol'watha temples, in the Hinterlands' north by northeast.

faq.q: Which Vilebranch does Yayo'jin want destroyed?
aliases: who do i kill for cannibalistic cousins
faq.answer: Yayo'jin wants the Vilebranch Scalpers and Vilebranch Soothsayers destroyed.
Zul'jin is not in the Hinterlands. Yayo'jin says he could wipe out the Vilebranch with ease, but he is away, leaving the Revantusk to their own devices.
